sections.zh:
当[GetHomeWorldName]上的其他生命在只能在荒野中度过夜晚，我们的祖先很快学习到了在地下生活的智慧，地下为他们提供了阻挡猛烈阳光和剧烈气候的庇荫。

对地底矿物的轻易获取让我们的[GetSpeciesAdj]先祖完成了工业化，统一了我们的物种并深化了穴居的文明形式。我们数次尝试重回地表但每次都只能带来残酷而难于应付的回忆。因此我们还是留在了地下，在星球的根基处建立我们至高无上的地位。

现在随着我们首台[GetStartingDrivePlural]的发现，我们做出了有史以来最大胆的尝试。如同我们的祖先在黑暗中的开拓一般，我们必须在星间的虚空中开凿出我们自己的新家园。
sections.en:
While other beings on [GetHomeWorldName] would spend their nights out in the wilds, our ancestors soon learned the wisdom of underground dwellings, sheltered from harsh light and climates.

Easy access to the below-ground minerals allowed our [GetSpeciesAdj] predecessors to industrialize, unifying our species and furthering our cavernous civilization. There were numerous attempts to return to the surface, but each time, it proved brutal and unforgiving. So, we remained below, establishing our dominance within our planet's foundations.

Now, with the discovery of our first [GetStartingDrivePlural], we make our boldest attempt yet. Just as our ancestors did in the darkness below the surface, we must now carve out homes in the void between the stars.

sections.zh:
我们生于[GetHomeWorldName]极深的地下。我们的进化之路和我们那些不可移动的表兄弟不同，他们在上方如同哨兵般环卫者我们，而我们却选择远离严酷而闪耀的日光。和他们不同，我们获得了移动、思考以及建立一个文明的能力。

对地底矿物的轻易获取让我们的[GetSpeciesAdj]先祖完成了工业化，统一了我们的物种并深化了穴居的文明形式。我们数次尝试重回地表但每次都只能带来残酷而难于应付的回忆。因此我们还是留在了地下，在星球的根基处建立我们至高无上的地位。

现在随着我们首台[GetStartingDrivePlural]的发现，我们做出了有史以来最大胆的尝试。如同我们的祖先在黑暗中的开拓一般，我们必须在星间的虚空中开凿出我们自己的新家园。
sections.en:
We are born from the very depths of [GetHomeWorldName]. Away from the harsh glare of starlight, our evolutionary path diverged from that of our immobile cousins, who remain like sentinels above and around us. Unlike them, we gained the ability to move, think, and form a civilization.

Easy access to the below-ground minerals allowed our [GetSpeciesAdj] predecessors to industrialize, unifying our species and furthering our cavernous civilization. There were numerous attempts to return to the surface, but each time, it proved brutal and unforgiving. So, we remained below, establishing our dominance within our planet's foundations.

Now, with the discovery of our first [GetStartingDrivePlural], we make our boldest attempt yet. Just as our ancestors did in the darkness below the surface, we must now carve out homes in the void between the stars.

sections.zh:
[GetHomeWorldName]上的生命采取了一些完全不同的进化路线。和我们同处一颗星球的其他生命形式不同，它们从阳光中汲取能量而我们从阴暗的地底获得营养，正如我们的[GetSpeciesAdj]先祖所做的那样。

对地底矿物的轻易获取让我们的[GetSpeciesAdj]先祖完成了工业化，统一了我们的物种并深化了穴居的文明形式。我们数次尝试重回地表但每次都只能带来残酷而难于应付的回忆。因此我们还是留在了地下，在星球的根基处建立我们至高无上的地位。

现在随着我们首台[GetStartingDrivePlural]的发现，我们做出了有史以来最大胆的尝试。如同我们的祖先在黑暗中的开拓一般，我们必须在星间的虚空中开凿出我们自己的新家园。
sections.en:
Life on [GetHomeWorldName] has taken some radically different routes. Unlike the other lifeforms with whom we share this world, deriving their energy from sunlight: we take our nutrients from deep within the murky ground, as our [GetSpeciesAdj] ancestors did.

Easy access to the below-ground minerals allowed our [GetSpeciesAdj] predecessors to industrialize, unifying our species and furthering our cavernous civilization. There were numerous attempts to return to the surface, but each time, it proved brutal and unforgiving. So, we remained below, establishing our dominance within our planet's foundations.

Now, with the discovery of our first [GetStartingDrivePlural], we make our boldest attempt yet. Just as our ancestors did in the darkness below the surface, we must now carve out homes in the void between the stars.

无。 None.
